clues.text: The law of Moses said not to muzzle this animal while it was treading out the grain.
Driven away from mankind, King Nebuchadnezzar ate grass like this animal until his sanity returned.
Through Isaiah, God said this animal knows its owner, but His people Israel do not know Him.
Jesus asked the Pharisees which of them would not pull out a son or this animal fallen into a pit on the Sabbath.
At Sinai, God commanded Israel not to covet a neighbor's house, wife, servants, donkey, or this animal.
In Ezekiel's vision, each living creature had the face of a man, a lion, an eagle, and this animal.
Under the law given through Moses, if this animal gored a man or woman to death, it was stoned.
